title: Everyone’s switching from ChatGPT to Claude right now …
description:
Everyone’s switching from ChatGPT to Claude right now… but 95% of people are using it wrong. 👀

If you’re starting with Claude, do these 5 things immediately:

✅ Turn on memory & capabilities
✅ Import your ChatGPT memory into Claude
✅ Connect Gmail, Drive & Calendar
✅ Customize Claude to match your workflow
✅ Enable Dispatch so Claude can work from your phone

Most people use AI like a chatbot.
Power users use it like an executive assistant. 🚀

The difference is setup.

And once Claude understands who you are, how you work, and what tools you use… it becomes insanely powerful.

AI isn’t replacing skilled people.
It’s amplifying the ones who learn fastest.
